Dyson Supersonic r HD17 Ceramic Pink and Rose Gold Hair Dryer

The Dyson Supersonic r HD17 in Ceramic Pink and Rose Gold is Dyson's most advanced and most capable hair dryer ever made. The precision hair dryer features the latest technology within a re-engineered, lightweight format that streamlines and evenly heats powerful airflow. It is Dyson's most powerful yet lightest hair dryer. Precision drying for a smoother finish, more shine, with up to 46% reduction in frizz and no heat damage. It comes with a complimentary Presentation case and five Intelligent attachments, each preset by experts for specific styling results.

The Ceramic Pink and Rose Gold colourway is one of the most popular in the Supersonic r range. It is the same colourway that spans across Dyson's Airwrap and Airstrait range, making this an ideal addition for someone building a matching Dyson hair care collection, or as a premium standalone gift.

What Makes the Supersonic r HD17 Different From Every Other Hair Dryer

Most hair dryers work by blasting hot air at your hair. The amount of heat varies, but the fundamental approach is the same — high temperature air accelerates the evaporation of water from the hair shaft. The problem is that the heat required to dry hair quickly is also the heat that damages it. Cuticle cracking, protein breakdown and colour fade all accelerate with repeated high-temperature drying.

The Dyson Supersonic r HD17 approaches drying differently. The Streamlined flow heater and attachments combine to create Dyson's most precise hair dryer, for a smoother finish and more shine. 10 heater foils are placed in the curve of the device for air to travel through, engineered to focus heat and airflow evenly where you need it for fast drying, precise styling, and a salon finish. Even heat distribution means no hot spots burning sections of hair while cooler air passes over others. Every part of the hair being dried receives the same controlled temperature at the same time.

30% Smaller, 20% Lighter, More Powerful Than Ever

Designed to be 30% smaller and 20% lighter, this device has been engineered to dry and style with control and comfort where it's hard to reach. At 325g body weight, it is exceptionally light for a hair dryer of this power. The size and weight reduction is made possible by moving primary electronics into the plug itself, removing that bulk from the machine. This engineering approach has enabled Dyson to create such a lightweight and compact product, which 98% of owners found easy to manoeuvre and 96% found effortlessly dries the back of their head. Reaching the sections at the back and sides, which are always the most difficult to dry evenly, is dramatically easier with the HD17 than with any conventional hair dryer.

Key Features

Dyson Hyperdymium Motor

The Dyson Hyperdymium motor produces high-pressure airflow, spinning at up to 110,000 RPM, forming a jet of controlled air. Propelled through the ultra-responsive Streamlined flow heater, 10 heater foils placed in the curve of the device heat air evenly for fast drying, precise styling, and a salon finish. This is the same motor engineering philosophy applied across Dyson's entire hair care range, optimised specifically for the demands of a hair dryer.

Five Intelligent Attachments With RFID Memory

Five Intelligent attachments are preset to the right temperature and airflow to perfect your style. RFID chips within the attachments remember the last used setting. When you connect an attachment, the dryer recognises it and immediately applies the settings you used last time with that specific attachment. No manual adjustment between attachments, no resetting every time you switch from diffusing to concentrating. Your preferences are stored and applied automatically.

Up to 46% Reduction in Frizz

The Supersonic r reduces static to reduce frizz by up to 46% and controls flyaways using negatively charged ions. The ioniser built into the device releases negatively charged particles into the airflow throughout your drying session. These ions neutralise the static charge in your hair that causes frizz and flyaways. For women in Karachi dealing with coastal humidity or in Lahore where summer heat and dust cause persistent frizz, this is one of the most practically relevant features of the HD17.

No Heat Damage

The HD17 uses intelligent heat control throughout every drying session. Temperatures are managed to stay below the threshold that causes damage to the hair cuticle and protein structure. By styling with airflow, hair is left to look and feel healthier, helping to maintain its natural strength. 94% of users agree their hair looks and feels soft. Drying your hair every day with the HD17 does not produce the same cumulative damage that repeated use of a conventional high-heat dryer does over months and years.

The Stylists' Choice

The Dyson Supersonic r hair dryer was developed with professional stylists. Over 100 professionals tested the device and over 90% agreed the Supersonic r achieves a salon finish, controls flyaways, reduces frizz and enhances curl definition. It is not just a consumer hair dryer that claims professional results. It is a tool that was co-developed and validated by working stylists before it was ever released to the public.

What Attachments Are Included

The HD17 comes with five Intelligent attachments, each designed for a specific drying and styling purpose:

  • Pro Concentrator — a wide, thin blade of air for precision styling and smooth blowouts
  • Powerful Air Attachment — produces high-velocity airflow for fast, efficient rough drying
  • Diffuser — disperses airflow to reduce frizz and define curls, coils and waves
  • Flyaway Attachment — harnesses the Coanda effect to lift longer hairs and hide flyaways for a smooth, shiny finish
  • Gentle Air Attachment — fast yet gentle for comfortable up-close drying and styling, ideal for scalp-sensitive use

Complimentary Presentation Case

The Ceramic Pink and Rose Gold Dyson Supersonic r hair dryer comes with a Presentation case to neatly store the machine and protect the attachments. All five attachments and the device store cleanly in the case, keeping everything organised and protected. For gifting purposes, the unboxing experience is premium from the moment the case is opened.

Why the Dyson Supersonic r Over Every Other Hair Dryer in Pakistan

Pakistan's market has hair dryers from Philips, Panasonic, Remington, Braun and dozens of cheaper brands. All of them work on the same principle and most of them run hot enough to cause visible hair damage over time. None of them have intelligent attachments that auto-adapt settings, none have a Streamlined flow heater with 10 foils for even heat distribution, and none were developed with over 100 professional stylists before launch.

The Supersonic r HD17 is the only hair dryer in the Pakistani market that dries faster, frizzes less, weighs less and protects hair better than every alternative available at any price point. It is the right choice for anyone who blows dry their hair regularly and wants the results to look genuinely good, not just dry.

Specifications

  • Model: HD17 Supersonic r
  • Colour: Ceramic Pink and Rose Gold
  • Voltage: 220-240V (Pakistan compatible)
  • Motor: Dyson Hyperdymium, up to 110,000 RPM
  • Body Weight: 325g
  • Frizz Reduction: Up to 46%
  • Attachments: 5 Intelligent attachments with RFID memory
  • Includes: Complimentary Presentation Case
  • Warranty: 2 years
  • Best For: All hair types, precision drying and styling

What does the name Kanzan Pink mean?

Kanzan is the name of a specific variety of Japanese cherry blossom tree, scientifically known as Prunus serrulata Kanzan. Dyson named this colourway after it because the soft, warm pastel pink finish is inspired by the gentle tones of cherry blossom. It is the same Kanzan Pink used across Dyson's Airwrap range, making it a cohesive choice for anyone who already owns or plans to own other Dyson products in this colourway.

The HD17 is engineered for the voltage of the country where it is purchased, so always confirm voltage before buying from any seller other than Vision Tech.

What are the five attachments included and what does each do?

The five Intelligent attachments are the Pro Concentrator for precision blowouts and smooth styling, the Powerful Air Attachment for fast high-velocity rough drying, the Diffuser for defining and enhancing curls, coils and waves with reduced frizz, the Flyaway Attachment that uses the Coanda effect to smooth and hide flyaways for a shiny finish, and the Gentle Air Attachment for comfortable up-close drying suitable for scalp-sensitive use. Each attachment is preset to the right temperature and airflow and RFID chips within the attachments remember the last used setting.

How does the RFID memory in the attachments work?

RFID chips within the attachments communicate with the HD17 to instantly adapt to the last-used setting, every time. When you connect an attachment, the device recognises exactly what is fitted and applies the settings you used last time with that specific attachment. Switch from the diffuser to the concentrator and the device adjusts automatically. No manual heat or speed readjustment needed between attachments.

Why does the HD17 reduce frizz better than other hair dryers?

The HD17 reduces static to reduce frizz by up to 46% and controls flyaways using negatively charged ions. The built-in ioniser releases negatively charged particles into the airflow throughout drying. These ions cancel the positive static charge that builds up in hair during drying, which is the root cause of frizz and flyaways. Most conventional hair dryers do not have an ioniser at this level, which is why they leave hair frizzier after drying than the HD17 does.

How is the HD17 30% smaller and 20% lighter if it is also more powerful?

Dyson incorporated primary electronics into the plug itself rather than the machine handle, shedding weight and bulk from the machine body. By moving the motor drive circuitry out of the handle and into the plug, Dyson was able to reduce the size and weight of the actual device dramatically while simultaneously increasing the motor speed and power output. The result is a lighter, smaller device that outperforms every heavier conventional dryer on the market.

Yes. The Diffuser attachment included with the HD17 is specifically engineered for curly, coily and wavy hair. The Diffuser helps reduce frizz and define curls, coils and waves. For women with naturally curly hair in Pakistan who want to enhance their natural curl pattern rather than straighten it, the Diffuser attachment on the HD17 gives results that conventional dryers cannot match. The even heat distribution also means curly hair is dried without the hot spots that cause curl frizz during drying.

What is the filter cleaning indicator on the HD17?

The Dyson Supersonic r HD17 informs owners of when they need to clean their filter with a yellow flashing LED on the handle, just above the filter. When the yellow LED begins flashing, it is time to clean the filter. Dyson recommends cleaning once a month for optimal performance. The filter removes debris from the airflow before it enters the motor, which protects the motor and maintains drying performance over the long term.
